The following events took place in '''51 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Jafer Torles]] became the [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]] of the [[Prackla sector/Legends|Prackla sector]].<ref name="Hero of Cartao">{{InsiderCite|issue1=68|issue2=70|Hero of Cartao}}</ref>
*[[Jorus C'baoth]] began his service as the personal advisor to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
*[[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]] brought [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]].
*The [[Summertime War]]s began on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]].
*[[Thak Val Zsing]] became head of [[Desert Wind]] on [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]].
*[[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee Naberrie]] [[Marriage/Legends|marries]] [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal]].<ref name="FF140">{{FactFile|140|FAM 1-2|Skywalker Family Tree}}</ref>
